Craft Agents 0.3.1 just shipped and I wanted to walk through what's actually useful about it.

The core idea: one desktop app that connects to all your stuff — GitHub, Calendar, Slack, your docs, local files — and lets you work across all of them in a single conversation. No more copy-pasting context between tools.

🔗 Download: https://agents.craft.do
🔗 Source code: https://github.com/lukilabs/craft-agents-oss
🔗 Beautiful mermaid repo: https://github.com/lukilabs/beautiful-mermaid

What's new in 0.3.1:

Session search — Cmd+F across your entire history, instant results
Mini agents — lightweight inline agents for quick config changes
Better diagrams — Mermaid renders natively with a proper zoom/pan viewer
What I like about it:

Actually respects your workflow with permission modes (read-only → ask first → full auto)
Everything's stored locally with encrypted credentials
Open source (Apache 2.0) so you can poke around the code
Built on the same foundation as Claude Code
Not sponsored, just genuinely find it useful for my day-to-day. If you're bouncing between GitHub, docs, and calendar all day, give it a try.
